2171/2023) and judgment and award dated 18.03.20215 (in FA Nos.
2178/2023, 2179/2023 and 2180/2023) passed by the Reference Court, the original claimants -appellants have filed this first appeals seeking enhancement of compensation on the ground of parity.
Reliance is placed on consistent view taken in awarding rate of Rs. 2,500/- per Are for the lands acquired from village Moregaon Tq. Sailu Dist. Parbhani.
The notification under Section 4 of the L.A. Act, was issued on 14.03.2001 for the purpose of Nima Dudhna Project.
Appellants are stated to have been deprived of escalation by cumulative effect.
3. The submissions of the claimants - appellants are contested by the respondents.
It is submitted that no case is made out for enhancement and ground of parity is not available to them.
4. Appellants lands from village Moregaon, Tq. Sailu have been acquired for the Nima Dudhna Project.
The classification of lands has not been challenged by the respondent-acquiring body.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Appellants are entitled to receive rate of Rs. 3750/- per Are for semi-irrigated land, Rs. 5000/- per Are for fully irrigated land, and escalation for 4 years at the rate of Rs. 10% per annum.
The first appeals are allowed partly.
B. The appellants are entitled to compensation at the rate of Rs. 6012/- per Are for semi-irrigated land and Rs. 8016/- per Are for fully irrigated land.
C. The appellants shall not be entitled to interest and statutory benefits 939 FA 2171 23+.odt for the delayed period.
D. The appellants shall be entitled to receive interest U/Sec. 28 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act in view of the judgment of the Full Bench of this Court in the matter of the State of Maharashtra Vs.
Kailas Shiva Rangari reported in 2016(4) All MR 513.
E.
Save and except above, the impugned judgments and awards shall remain unaltered.
F. The appellants shall pay the deficit court fees.
G. Award be drawn up accordingly.
